name: Shemeshka

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Torc of Bin A’kin
traits.details: When subject to an effect that imposes the dominated condition that a save can end, Shemeshka can make a saving throw against that effect.

hit.description: damage, and the target is blinded (save ends).

powers.name: Mind Lure
powers.requirements: Shemeshka must be in friendly fiend form.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is pulled 5 squares and dazed (save ends).

effect.description: Shemeshka can alter her physical form to take on the form of A’kin the Friendly Fiend, or return to her form as Shemeshka the Marauder. When she takes on the marauder form, she can use call groom guardians. When she is in friendly fiend form, she can use mind lure.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target moves its speed away from Shemeshka.

effect.description: One creature that Shemeshka can see must choose to take ongoing 20 psychic damage (save ends) or be dominated (save ends).

powers.name: Call Groom Guardians
powers.requirements: Shemeshka must be in marauder form.

effect.description: Shemeshka summons five groom guardians. Each groom guardian appears in an unoccupied square within 10 squares of Shemeshka.

powers.name: Enforce Contract
powers.trigger: Shemeshka is hit by an enemy’s melee or ranged attack.

effect.description: A creature affected by Shemeshka’s bind power becomes the target of the triggering attack. Using this power ends the effect of bind on that creature.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.trigger: Shemeshka is hit by an enemy.

effect.description: Shemeshka shifts 3 squares and is invisible until the end of her next turn or until she attacks.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: Shemeshka takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: Shemeshka gains resist 15 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until she uses variable resistance again.
